snippet.title: TARIA & COMO - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Developed by Kip Henderson and JuVee Productions, “Taria & Como” is a physics-based puzzle platformer featuring a disabled protagonist and where movement is built around swinging instead of jumping. Coming to Playdate Season 2!
